urpose | Agenda Item R4-2520890 | CR | CR on pre-compensation for timing error requirement for IoT NTN TDD (Clause 7.20B.2) | LG Electronics Inc. | Agreement | 4.27.4 R4-2521733 | CR | CR with Editorial Correction for IoT NTN TDD Requirements | Nokia | Agreement | 4.27.4 R4-2521735 | CR | (IoT_NTN_TDD-Perf) CR on removing support for segmented precompensation | Nokia | Agreement | 4.27.4 R4-2521652 | CR | CR on core requirements for IoT NTN TDD | Huawei, HiSilicon | Agreement | 4.27.4 Table 10: TDoc Number | Company | General Purpose | Agenda Item R4-2521629 | Huawei, HiSilicon | Agreement | 4.11.2.3 Table 11: T-doc number | Company | Proposals / Observations R4-2521540 | ZTE Corporation, Sanechips | Observation 1: There is a controversial between RAN2 understanding and RAN4 specification description on SMTC selection if more than 4SMTCs are configured by network. Proposal 1: RAN4 shall clarify the principle on SMTC selection if more than 4SMTCs are configured with RAN2 understanding. Observation 2: If UE is capable of twoSMTC-Periodicities-r19, UE supports NTN SSB based RRM measurements on target cells using two SMTC periodicities on a single frequency carrier. If UE does not support this capability, UE will have same periodicity with smtc1. Proposal 2: RAN4 shall consider RAN4 specification description with RAN2 outcome on two different SMTC periodicities. R4-2521730 | Nokia | Observation 1: In the example of Figure 1, the requirements related to SMTC1 are expanded by 2, even though only 1/8 of the SMTC occasions are colliding with other SMTCs. Proposal 1: When SMTCs with different periodicities collide, for measurements purposes, the SMTC with longer periodicity shall always take precedence over the SMTC with shortest periodicity. Observation 2: In the example above, the total time for the UE to have 5 measurement opportunities in SMTC2 will be enhanced from 1285 ms to 645 ms. Proposal 2: The value of K_multi_SMTC is to be calculated only considering SMTCs with same periodicity. Proposal 3: For SMTCs with shorter periodicity that overlap with SMTCs with larger periodicity the formula for the measurement requirements shall consider a factor L_multi_SMTC, which corresponds to the number of measurement opportunities lost due to collision with SMTCs with larger periodicity within 5 SMTC occasions. Proposal 4: Adopt proposals 3, 4 and 5 for all cases in which the longest SMTC periodicity equals 160 ms, and in the other cases, adopt the proposal from RAN4 #116: Kmulti_SMTC,i = maxj(Kmulti_SMTC,i,j), where Kmulti_SMTC,i,j is calculated in the legacy way for the j-th occasion of SMTC#i. R4-2521217 | Ericsson | Proposal 1: We are open to the solutions of optimizing value of Kmulti_SMTC,i to mitigate the degradation of long SMTC periodicity. Proposal 2: RAN4 to take below scaling factor into account of Kmulti_SMTC,i optimization. Koccupy,i : = 1-SMTCi / MAX(SMTC), if SMTCi < MAX(SMTC) = 1, if SMTCi = MAX(SMTC) Kmulti_SMTC,i only calculates the collsion between SMTCs with same periodicity Table 9.2C.5.1-1: Time period for PSS/SSS detection, (Frequency range FR1-NTN) Proposal 3: K_satellite in inter-frequency measurement requirements shall be updated in the same way as Kmulti_SMTC.

Malta, MT, 19th – 23rd May, 2025 Agenda item: 7.12.1 Document for: Information Introduction In RAN #106 meeting, the objectives for the revised WID RP-243285are: In RAN4#110bis meeting, the WF R4-2406089 was approved, and the work plan can be found in R4-2404692. In RAN4#111 meeting, the WF R4-2409957 was approved. In RAN4#112 meeting, the WF R4-2413510 was approved. In RAN4 #112bis meeting, the agreements in the chairman’s note are: Chair: The agreed way forward is to postpone the discussion on TAE rewording until the conclusion of the December plenary meeting. No further delay is expected. In RAN4 #113 meeting, the WF R4-2419796 was approved. In RAN4 #114 meeting, the draft CR R4-2502280 to introduce ATG BS CA to TS38.104 was endorsed. In RAN4 #114 bis meeting, the WF R4-2504704 was approved, and meanwhile, the following two draft CR were endorsed. - R4-2504702 for TS38.141-1 - R4-2504703 for TS38.141-2 For the thread [115][305] NR_ATG_enh, the contributions under AI:7.12.3 for RF requirements and AI: 7.12.4 for test requirement are treated. Topic #2: ATG BS CA test requirements (AI: 7.12.4) Issue 2-1: draft CRs for R4-2506026 Recommended WF Endorsed? It is formal CR for endorsed draft CR in last meeting, but this WID will be completed in Sep. RAN#109 meeting, all of the formal CR are expected to be available and agreed in Aug. RAN4 #116 meeting. [Tables] Table 1: The core part of this work item includes Specify the RF and RRM core requirements for intra-band co-located and inter-band co-located DL CA [RAN4]: FR1 intra-band contiguous CA Example band combination: CA_n79C FR1+FR1 inter-band CA Example band combination: CA_n3A-n39A Specify the RF requirements for support of UL MIMO with 2TX for single CC for UE. [RAN4] Specify the TAE requirements for support of DL MIMO for BS. [RAN4]. Specify signaling and UE capabilities if necessary [RAN2]. The performance part of the work item includes: Specify corresponding RRM performance and demodulation requirements for intra-band co-located and inter-band co-located DL CA. Specify corresponding demodulation requirements for support of UL MIMO with 2TX for single CC for UE with dual-polarization antenna. Specify demodulation requirements for support of DL MIMO for UE with limited test cases. Specify conformance testing and conformance requirements for BS. Table 2: TDoc | Source | Title R4-2506026 | CATT, ZTE Corporation, CMCC, Huawei, Ericsson | (NR_ATG_enh-Perf)CR for 38.141-1, Introduction of R19 ATG enhancement BS RF requirements Introduce R19 ATG enhancement BS RF requirements. This is formal CR for endorsed draft CR R4-2504702 in RAN4#114bis.
